item.title: Bucks Not Ready To Wave White Flag, Could Make Major Move
item.description: The Bucks are floundering but they’re not ready to wave the white flag, The Athletic’s Eric Nehm reports. In fact, Nehm hears the Bucks have told teams they are looking to add to their roster in hopes of fortifying their struggling team.
